title: Day of the Dragon King
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie save an ancient Chinese legend from the Dragon King's fire! 杰克和安妮从龙王的烈火中抢救出一个中国古代传说！

q.en: Over 2,000 years ago, what creature did the first emperor choose as his symbol, earning him the name "Dragon King"?
q.zh: 两千多年前，第一位皇帝选择了哪种动物作为自己的象征，因而被称为“龙王”？

explain.en: Jack reads that the first emperor chose the dragon as his symbol, so he was called the "Dragon King." In China dragons are seen as brave and powerful.
explain.zh: 杰克读到，第一位皇帝选择了龙作为象征，因此被称为“龙王”。在中国，龙被视为勇敢而强大的生物。

q.en: The young cowherd asks Jack and Annie to give a message to the silk weaver. What is it?
q.zh: 放牛的年轻人让杰克和安妮给织绸女带一句话。是什么话？

options.en: Meet me in the field at twilight.
Please meet me at the busy market at noon.
options.zh: 请中午在热闹的集市见我。

explain.en: The young man tending the cows asks them to tell the silk weaver to meet him in the field at twilight — and the two are later reunited there.
explain.zh: 放牛的年轻人请他们转告织绸女，黄昏时到田里见他——后来两人果然在那里重逢。

q.en: According to the silk weaver, what is silk thread made from?
q.zh: 根据织绸女所说，丝线是用什么做成的？

options.en: the leaves of the mulberry tree

explain.en: The silk weaver tells Jack that silk is made from the cocoons of silkworms, and warns that stealing the secret is punished by death.
explain.zh: 织绸女告诉杰克，丝是用蚕茧做成的，并警告说偷走这个秘密会被处死。

q.en: Why did the Dragon King order the burning of all the books in the Imperial Library?
q.zh: 龙王为什么要下令烧掉皇家图书馆里所有的书？

options.en: he feared the power of books and learning
options.zh: 他害怕书籍和知识的力量

options.en: he simply wanted to keep his palace warm in winter
options.zh: 他只是想让宫殿冬天暖和一些

options.en: the books were old and torn
he disliked the color of the bamboo

explain.en: The scholar explains that the Dragon King is afraid of the power of books and learning, so he orders all the books in the Imperial Library to be burned.
explain.zh: 学者解释说，龙王害怕书籍和知识的力量，所以下令烧掉皇家图书馆里所有的书。

q.en: After later emperors made it even longer, how long did the Great Wall stretch?
q.zh: 后来的皇帝把它修得更长之后，万里长城总长达到了多少？

explain.en: Jack reads that the Dragon King forced subjects to build a wall, and later emperors extended it until it stretched 3,700 miles — the longest structure ever built.
explain.zh: 杰克读到，龙王强迫百姓修墙，后来的皇帝不断加长，最终达到 3,700 英里——是有史以来最长的人造建筑。

q.en: For his burial tomb, what did the Dragon King have made — thousands of them, life-size?
q.zh: 龙王为自己的陵墓制作了成千上万个什么（和真人一样大小）？

options.en: marble statues of horses and chariots
options.zh: 大理石的马与战车雕像

explain.en: Inside the tomb Jack and Annie find 7,000 life-size clay figures — baked and painted soldiers, archers, and chariots meant to protect the Dragon King.
explain.zh: 在陵墓里，杰克和安妮发现了 7,000 个真人大小的陶土人像——烧制并上色的士兵、弓箭手和战车，用来保护龙王。

q.en: Deep inside the tomb, what magical object rolls out of Jack's sack and leaves a trail of thread to guide them out?
q.zh: 在陵墓深处，是什么神奇的东西从杰克的袋子里滚出来，留下一条丝线指引他们逃出？

options.en: the ball of yellow silk thread
a small glowing lantern with a flame
options.zh: 一盏燃着小火苗的发光提灯

explain.en: The ball of yellow silk thread the silk weaver gave Annie rolls out and leaves a trail that leads Jack and Annie safely out of the tomb.
explain.zh: 织绸女送给安妮的那团黄色丝线球滚了出来，留下一条线，把杰克和安妮安全地引出了陵墓。

q.en: According to the scholar, when do the city gates close and the bridge comes up, sealing the city for the night?
q.zh: 根据学者的说法，城门在一天的什么时候关闭、吊桥收起，把城市封锁到天亮？

explain.en: The scholar says the gates close every day at sunset: when the gong sounds, the gates shut, the bridge comes up, and the city is sealed for the night.
explain.zh: 学者说城门每天日落时关闭：锣声一响，城门关上、吊桥收起，城市就被封锁到天亮。

q.en: What is the name of the ancient Chinese legend that Jack and Annie bring safely home?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮安全带回家的中国古代传说，叫什么名字？

options.en: The Tale of the Great Wall
The Silk Weaver and the Cowherd
The Dragon, the Phoenix, and the Pearl

explain.en: Morgan tells them the legend is called The Silk Weaver and the Cowherd, about two heavenly beings who fell in love when they came to earth.
explain.zh: 摩根告诉他们，这个传说叫《织绸女与放牛郎》，讲的是两位天上神仙下凡相爱的故事。

q.en: In the legend, what makes a bridge across the Milky Way once a year so the silk weaver and cowherd can meet?
q.zh: 在这个传说里，每年是什么在银河上搭起一座桥，让织绸女和放牛郎得以相会？

explain.en: Morgan says that once a year, birds make a bridge in the sky over the Milky Way so the two lovers can be together (in the legend, magpies build it).
explain.zh: 摩根说，每年有一次，鸟儿在银河上搭起一座桥，让这对恋人相会（传说中是喜鹊搭的桥）。
